description: Land Aquisition - Habaragahamada, Naula D/S Division, Matale District Sec 38 (b)
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring servitude over multiple land lots for the construction of the Bowathenna Tunnel and North Western Province Canal Project. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, lot numbers, extents, and locations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the core land acquisition purpose and does not involve government structural changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government-related classification.
